table.name: File name
table.emptyHint: Paste a link, press Add URL, or download from your browser.

add.title: New download
add.urlPlaceholder: Paste one or more links (YouTube, Spotify, direct files…). Patterns like file[01-20].zip work too.
add.spotifyNote: Songs are matched on YouTube and saved with Spotify's title, artist and cover.
add.thumbnailHint: Saves the video’s cover image (JPG) in full size, without downloading the video.
add.subtitlesHint: Saves subtitles as .srt files. Where nobody wrote subtitles, the site's automatic (and auto-translated) ones are used.

settings.title: Settings
settings.minimizeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.categoryFolders: Sort into category folders (Video, Music, Programs…)
settings.browserEnabled: Take over downloads from the browser
settings.confirmBrowser: Show the download dialog before starting
settings.skipDomains: Never take over from these sites
settings.extensionHint: Downloads, videos and playlists from your browser open straight in Downly.
settings.cookiesFrom: Use cookies from browser (age-restricted / private videos)
settings.subtitles: Add subtitles to videos (automatic ones when there are none)
settings.takeAll: Take every file the browser downloads (off: only the types below)

dialogs.deleteFiles: Also delete the files from disk
dialogs.refreshHint: Paste a fresh link for the same file. Progress is kept.

support.title: Support Downly
support.body: Downly is completely free, with no ads and no tracking. If it saves you time, a small donation helps keep it alive and updated. Thank you!
support.cardBody: No ads, no limits. If Downly helps you, consider supporting it.
support.instapayScan: Or scan the code with your bank app / InstaPay

ext.title: Connect your browser
ext.intro: Add the Downly extension so downloads, videos and playlists from your browser open in Downly. Pick your browser:
ext.noBrowsers: No supported browser was found. Install Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Firefox, then try again.
ext.step1: We opened the extensions page in {{browser}}
ext.step2Hint: The switch is in the top-right corner of the page.
ext.step2HintEdge: On Edge the switch is at the bottom of the left sidebar.
ext.step4Hint: The path is already copied: paste it into the address bar at the top of the window (Ctrl+V), then click “Select Folder”.
ext.step4HintLinux: The path is already copied: press Ctrl+L, paste it (Ctrl+V), then click “Select”.
ext.step4HintMac: The path is already copied: press ⌘ Cmd + Shift + G, paste it (⌘ V), press Return, then click “Select”.
ext.firefoxAdd: Click “Add” in the Firefox window that just opened.
ext.firefoxTemp1: In the Firefox page that opened, click “Load Temporary Add-on…”.
ext.firefoxTemp2: Open this folder and choose the file manifest.json
ext.firefoxTempNote: Firefox removes temporary add-ons when it closes. A permanent one-click version is coming soon.
ext.waiting: Waiting for the extension to connect…
ext.connected: Connected! Downly now works with your browser.

idm.title: IDM might take your downloads
idm.intro: Internet Download Manager is running on this PC. If its browser integration is on, it catches downloads before Downly can, so they open in IDM instead. To let Downly handle them:
idm.step1: Open IDM, then the Downloads menu → Options
idm.step2: In the General tab, uncheck “Use advanced browser integration”
idm.step2Hint: Uncheck the browsers in the list next to it too, then click OK.
idm.step3: In your browser's extensions page, turn off “IDM Integration Module”
idm.note: Closing IDM isn't enough: its integration starts it again with the next download.

update.installing: Installing the update… Downly will open again by itself.
update.network: (the internet connection dropped, check it and try again)

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Tell us what happened. Downly saves a report file on your desktop and opens our WhatsApp chat, where you attach it.
report.placeholder: For example: the video from this site doesn't download, it says…
report.contains: The report includes the Downly and Windows versions, the log, and the links of your recent failed downloads. It has no passwords or saved files.
report.done: The report is on your desktop: {{name}}. Attach it in the WhatsApp chat that just opened.

subs.title: Follow channels
subs.intro: Add a YouTube channel, a playlist, or any channel link. Downly remembers what's already there and downloads new videos by itself (it checks every few hours while it's open).
subs.adding: Reading the channel… this can take a moment.

errors.drm: This video is encrypted (DRM), as on Netflix, Shahid or OSN. No downloader can save it, and breaking that protection is illegal.
errors.login: The site only shows this to signed-in users. Sign in to the site in your browser, then send the video from the browser extension.
errors.private: This video is private: only its owner (or people they allowed) can see it.
errors.gone: The video or file is no longer there (deleted, or the link is wrong).
errors.unsupported: Downly doesn't know this site. Open the page in your browser, play the video, and use the extension's Download button.
errors.geo: This video isn't available in your country.
errors.forbidden: The site refused the download. Try it from the browser extension, which sends the site the same details your browser used.
errors.rateLimited: The site is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
